case.title: Google Calendar sync stopped
case.subject: Appointments not showing in Google Calendar anymore
case.text:
Hello,

Since last week new Slotwise appointments don't show up in my Google Calendar. It used to work fine. I changed my Google password recently if that matters. My colleague's sync still works.

Daniel
case.why: Classic sync issue after a password change; the KB says disconnect and reconnect.

output.reply:
Hello Daniel,

Thanks for the details. Changing your Google password is very likely the cause. Google sometimes revokes access after a password change, which would explain why your colleague's sync still works and yours doesn't.

To fix it, please reconnect your calendar:
1. Go to Profile → Calendar sync.
2. Click Disconnect.
3. Click Connect Google Calendar and sign in with the Google account that owns the calendar.
4. Allow both permissions (view and edit events). If you skip one, sync will only work in one direction.
5. Check that the right calendars are selected to block availability.

Changes usually appear within 5 minutes after reconnecting.

If sync still doesn't work after reconnecting, reply to this email with your name and an example appointment that is missing from Google Calendar, and our team will check the sync log.

Best regards,
Slotwise Support
